<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 127.0997, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral molecular mass of ≈126.09 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass is C₈H₁₄O (exact mass 126.1045 Da), within typical experimental error and consistent with the observed isotopic pattern (no significant M+2 peak). Therefore the molecular formula of the compound is C8H14O.</thought>
<final_answer>C8H14O</final_answer>
